acceptanceCriteria: Cargo workspace verification applies CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and a stable shared target directory when the Runtime launches cargo.
Non-Cargo commands keep their declared environment and existing command behavior.
The selected environment is covered by focused tests and documented in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.
No verification process starts before the environment policy is resolved; no per-worktree target is created by the policy.
The policy and cleanup boundary are documented with equivalent facts in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.
goal: Make workspace Cargo verification use CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and one explicit shared target directory by default, preserve dependency reuse, document the cleanup boundary, and prove the selected environment is applied before any verification child process starts.
intent: Prevent verification runs from creating unbounded per-worktree Cargo target caches.
outOfScope: object repositories and their main branches
sources: user instruction: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR verification policy
